Project cell group scores onto trained NMF latent factors

project_factors.Rd

Applies the positive-negative split to new samples and projects them onto the latent space learned during training using the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse of the scaled basis matrix W. Negative values of the projection are set to 0 (on the tutorial data the result is the same as an exact non-negative projection). Cell groups missing in scores are tolerated with a warning naming them: the projection uses the other cell groups (on the tutorial data, with 20 of 144 cell groups missing, the factors still correlate 0.999 with the full projection).

Usage

project_factors(latent_factors, scores)

Arguments

latent_factors

A list returned by compute.latent_factors(), containing at minimum W (features x rank) and the RcppML model object with the nmf_model$d scaling vector.

scores

A samples x cell groups matrix of signed CCA composite scores for the test cohort. Column names must match those used in training (before the _pos/_neg suffix was added).

Value

A non-negative matrix of size samples x rank containing the projected NMF factor scores for the test cohort.

Details

The RcppML NMF decomposition is A = W %% diag(d) %% H, not A = W %*% H. The diagonal scaling vector d must be absorbed into W before computing the pseudoinverse, otherwise the projected scores are on the wrong scale.

Examples

data("network.tuto")
data("deconv_subgroups.tuto")
cell_groups <- construct_cell_groups(network.tuto, deconv_subgroups.tuto)
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled

#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled
#> Warning: Length of color vector was shorter than the number of clusters - color vector was recycled

#> Dendrogram plots saved to: Results/Dendrogram_color_clusters.pdf
#> 44 of 897 features were not assigned to any cluster by the tree cut and are not part of any cell group (pink: 2, yellow: 8, red: 2, blue: 6, brown: 4, turquoise: 12, black: 4, green: 6)
latent <- compute.latent_factors(cell_groups$Cell_groups, return = FALSE)
#> Estimating optimal rank via elbow on reconstruction MSE (ranks 2:8)...
#> MSE by rank: k2=0.00129  k3=0.00114  k4=0.00105  k5=0.000978  k6=0.000933  k7=0.000893  k8=0.000857
#> Selected rank (elbow): 3
#> Running RcppML NMF with rank = 3...
projected <- project_factors(latent, cell_groups$Cell_groups[1:10, ])
head(projected)
